whatIs: Chakra UI is a library of accessible React components for building web apps and design systems. You install it with npm i @chakra-ui/react and it works with Next.js, including server components.
It's a good fit when you work in React and want accessible pieces that you can customize through props, without writing the styles from scratch.
uses: Setting up an app's design system in React with your own theme.
Building accessible forms, dialogs and menus in a Next.js project.
Switching between light and dark mode with the provider its CLI generates.
caveats: It's React only, and requires Node.js 20 or later.
Installation requires extra packages (@emotion/react), the provider and changes to tsconfig or jsconfig.
It currently styles with Emotion at runtime; its plan is to migrate to runtime-free styles, so expect changes.
pricingNote: The library is open source; Chakra Pro's blocks and templates are sold separately, as a one-time payment.
idealFor: React teams looking for accessible components and custom themes.
